parameters.prompt: One complete small 图书馆 building for a bright cozy low-poly woodland social diorama. A miniature woodland library with a tall central book-shaped entrance tower, two low side wings, a broad shallow green roof, a large round reading window and carved open-book emblem. Distinct stepped silhouette, warmly lit reading windows. Use the supplied two views as massing guidance, enrich with appealing handmade architectural details. Warm light wood, pale cream stone, muted sage greens, soft faceted shapes, readable front door toward positive Z, complete back and sides. Approximate footprint 4 by 3.5 and height 3 to 4.2. Flat grounded bottom. Isolated building only, no ground slab, no landscape, no people, no readable text, no baked shadows, no separate loose props. Cohesive miniature architecture, light matte materials, no dark realistic concrete. Do not create an interior or a cutaway.

adoption: adopted after front/rear and nine-building in-scene review
note: Original Rodin geometry and texture retained. Orientation, uniform scale and floor alignment are applied at runtime; no new generation for individual groups.
